generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Work Completion period is 12 months (Including Monsoon)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 : Instructions to Tenderer I T T will only be considered for evaluation
To Qualify for award of this contract, each bidder should give all details and documents as per technical and financial bid attached to this tender
The bidders shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of each tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself 2 of 10 KPPP and should got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section
It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
The Tenderer should be a PWD Registered Class IV & above contractor.
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-1 KPWD and further orders thereon.
EMD Rs. 18,000/- By payments in favour of Executive Engineer PWD Division SIRSI.
Successful bidder should produce 5% of the Contract price plus difference amount for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract.
Any deviation / error / mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
GST will be paid as per the present rates at 18%, if GST revises (Increases or Decreases) same shall be paid accordingly as per the Govt Circular No. FD 417 EXP-12/2024 Dtd:09.08.2024

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26. Achieved in at least Two Financial years an average annual financial turnover Rs. 7.20 Lakhs (Turnover certificate without UDIN number is Treated Non Responsive)

If the rate quoted by the Successful Tenderer is less than the Amount put to tender, then the difference amount should be paid in the form of FDR / BG in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD Division Sirsi at the time of agreement.
GST-18% shall be paid to the tender amount separately
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual Maintenance and other repairs to Haliyal (SH 28) to B.K. Halli N.S.Koppa (SH 46) Road via Tatwanagi Amanakoppa (MDR 10092) From Km 5.00 to Km 10.92. in Haliyal taluk of Uttar Kannada District under 3054 MDR Maintenance for the year 2026-27

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -2- SITE CLEARANCE
itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -10- MAINTENANCE  OF ROADS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -10- MAINTENANCE  OF ROADS
itemList.description: Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Water Bound Macadam - Providing, laying, spreading and compacting stone aggregates of specific  sizes  to  water  bound  macadam  specification  including spreading   in   uniform   thickness,   hand   packing,   rolling   with vibratory roller in stages to proper grade and camber, applying and brooming requisite type of screening/ binding Materials to fill up the interstices of coarse aggregate, watering and compacting to the required density. - Mechanical means - Grading-II (53 mm to 22.4 mm) - Using Screening  Crushable type such as Moorum or Gravel. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 404 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Road Signs - Maintenance of road signs by way of cleaning and repainting of   mandatory   /   requlatory   /   cautionary   /   informatory and  place  identifications  sign  board  as  perdrawings  and technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1911 ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with B type Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Including cost of all materials, with all lead lift, Transporting to site, loading unloading, labour charges, HOM, etc complete as per specifications as per directions of Engineer-in-charge of Work
